userStories.title: Build QOF LSOA ingestion batch script
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a standalone script that reads QOF 2024-25 practice-level register data, GP geocoded coordinates, and GP list sizes, and produces a derived LSOA-level prevalence CSV, so that QOF data is ready for the app to load.
acceptanceCriteria: Script lives at scripts/analysis/build_qof_lsoa.py and accepts a --year argument (default 2024-25)
Script reads three inputs: QOF register CSV (practice code + disease prevalence %), GP geocoded CSV (practice code + lat/lon), GP list size CSV (practice code + list size)
For each LSOA centroid, computes weighted prevalence for CHD, COPD, diabetes, and depression using the top-5 nearest GP practices weighted by list_size / distance_km^2
Every LSOA receives a non-null value (guaranteed by top-5 nearest with no hard radius cutoff)
Output written to data/cache/qof_lsoa_{year}.csv with columns: LSOA_code, qof_chd_prevalence, qof_copd_prevalence, qof_diabetes_prevalence, qof_depression_prevalence
Script prints count of LSOAs processed and confirms output path on completion
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Remind user to supply the GP list size CSV file before running this script. The GP geocoded CSV is already in the repo.

userStories.title: Build OSRM walking travel-time matrix batch script
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a batch script that queries the OSRM table endpoint with all London LSOA centroids and saves a full LSOA-to-LSOA walking time matrix as parquet, so that walking travel times are available for instant runtime lookup.
acceptanceCriteria: Script lives at scripts/analysis/build_travel_time_matrix.py and accepts a --mode argument (walking|transit)
For mode=walking, script queries the OSRM table endpoint (router.project-osrm.org, profile=foot) with all LSOA centroids as both sources and destinations
Output is a parquet file at data/cache/travel_time_walking.parquet with columns: origin_lsoa, destination_lsoa, travel_time_minutes
Script handles OSRM batch size limits by chunking requests if needed
Script prints total LSOA pairs computed and output file size on completion

userStories.title: Create R5 Dockerfile and transit matrix batch script

acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile at scripts/analysis/r5/Dockerfile installs R5 (Conveyal) and its Java dependency

Output parquet has columns: origin_lsoa, destination_lsoa, travel_time_minutes
scripts/analysis/r5/README.md documents where to download London GTFS (TfL bus, Tube, Elizabeth line, national rail) and how to run the Docker container

userStories.title: Update _score_single_candidate() to use travel-time decay
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the candidate scoring function to substitute travel-time decay for distance decay when a routed mode is selected, so that hub scores reflect actual access rather than straight-line proximity.
acceptanceCriteria: _score_single_candidate() in webapp/analysis.py accepts an optional travel_time_matrix argument

LSOAs with travel time > 30 minutes receive weight 0 and are excluded from the catchment mean

userStories.title: Add methodology sections to docs/METHODOLOGY.md for all four features
userStories.description: As an ICB analyst, I want the Methodology page to include explanations of each enhancement layer, so that I can cite the data sources, attribution methods, and caveats to commissioners.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/METHODOLOGY.md gains four new sections: QOF Disease Prevalence, Ethnicity Indices, Travel-Time Catchments, Estate Availability Flags

QOF section states: register used per disease (CHD, COPD, diabetes, depression), weighted attribution formula (top-5 nearest, list_size / d^2), QOF year, and the caveat that QOF is recorded prevalence not epidemiological prevalence
Ethnicity section states: Census 2021 ONS TS021 source, the five derived fields and their exact ONS group mapping, and that these are an equity lens not a deprivation substitute

Travel-time section states: OSRM as walking provider, R5 with London GTFS as transit provider, Tuesday 10:00am departure assumption, continuous decay formula (1 - t/30), and band thresholds (0-10, 10-20, 20-30 min) for map colouring

Estate section states: ERIC 2024/25 as source, proximity-only scope in MVP, geocoding method (postcodes.io), default search radius (1 km), and that flags are informational and do not affect hub scores
Typecheck passes
